name: opencode-tui
label: OpenCode TUI
description: Production-supported runtime adapter for OpenCode TUI. Reuses AIKit core through workspace install/update flow and OpenCode-specific launcher files.

graph_execution.purpose: OpenCode runtime can inspect packaged workflow DAG metadata and graph-aware handoff hints from the installed workspace.

runtime_entrypoints.name: project-rules
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Project rules for OpenCode: the AIKit block (base + profile rules) is managed by the installer, user content outside it is kept.

runtime_entrypoints.name: opencode-runtime-guide
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Runtime-specific AIKit instructions for OpenCode workspaces.

runtime_entrypoints.name: continue-maintainer
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Continue developing AIKit inside OpenCode using the maintainer handoff prompt.

runtime_entrypoints.name: opencode-native-agents
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: AIKit agents as OpenCode subagents (mode: subagent).

runtime_entrypoints.name: opencode-native-skills
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: AIKit skills in the Agent Skills format that OpenCode discovers in the repository.

runtime_entrypoints.name: packaged-agents
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Canonical maintainer agent packaged for OpenCode runtime.

runtime_entrypoints.name: runtime-operating-protocol
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Rules for OpenCode agents to choose internal AIKit tools, memory updates and RAG refreshes without exposing scripts as the primary user interface.

runtime_entrypoints.name: runtime-continuation-contract
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Rules for resumed flows, bundle handoff, session lineage and next-step orchestration in OpenCode workspaces.

runtime_entrypoints.name: runtime-tools-registry
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Machine-readable registry of internal AIKit tools OpenCode agents can use for orchestration, memory, RAG and validation.

runtime_entrypoints.name: mcp-tool-plane
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Runtime-native MCP provider matrix for OpenCode agents, keeping Figma/GitHub tools separate from local shell commands.
